raw_response.guide: For the headline answer to "is this order still working?", use state_group ('open' vs 'closed'); raw state has finer granularity if the user asks why. For the fill price the user cares about, use average_price (VWAP across fills). cumulative_quantity vs quantity tells "how much filled?"; canceled_quantity only appears on partial-fill-then-cancel paths. Asset symbol is currency_code; pair UUID is currency_pair_id. For current market, call get_crypto_quotes with the pair symbol (construct as currency_code + "-USD" for USD-quoted pairs, or look up via get_currency_pairs) — get_crypto_quotes takes the symbol, NOT currency_pair_id. initiator_type tells how the order was placed (app / API / recurring / agent) — surface it when the agent didn't place this order. Per-fill executions[] are omitted from list responses to keep the page sized for an agent's context window; pass order_id to retrieve a single order with executions populated. Present currency_code, side, type, state, quantity (or cumulative_quantity when partially filled), average_price once filled, created_at, and id when cancellation may follow. When presenting multiple orders, add a Fee column when any order on the page carries fee or fee_rate. Every order on this page belongs to the account echoed in rhs_account_number / crypto_account_number.
